MT4-0328.stem: State offices of the Russian Federation are offices established by:

options.a: The Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the direct exercise of federal state bodies' powers, and offices established by the constitutions (charters) and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for the direct exercise of those entities' state bodies' powers
options.b: Federal laws for federal state bodies to exercise their powers
options.c: The Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the direct exercise of the powers of federal state bodies and state bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
options.d: The Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws for the indirect exercise of federal state bodies' powers

MT4-0329.stem: The principal federal law regulating the state civil service is:

options.a: Federal Law No. 79-FZ of 27 July 2004
options.b: Federal Law No. 25-FZ of 2 March 2007
options.c: Federal Law No. 39-FZ of 28 January 2011
options.d: Federal Law No. 59-FZ of 2 May 2006

MT4-0330.stem: The state civil service of the Russian Federation is:

options.a: A type of municipal service consisting of professional service activities of citizens of the Russian Federation
options.b: A type of state service consisting of professional service activities of citizens of the Russian Federation
options.c: A type of public activity consisting of socially significant activities of citizens of the Russian Federation
options.d: Performance of duties in elected offices

MT4-0331.stem: The state civil service in the Russian Federation is divided into:

options.a: Federal civil service and civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation
options.b: Federal civil service, civil service of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and municipal service
options.c: Civil service in executive, representative and judicial state bodies
options.d: Civil service within and outside the Russian Federation

MT4-0332.stem: The state-service system of the Russian Federation includes the following types:

options.a: Civil service and military service
options.b: Federal service and municipal service
options.c: Civil service and municipal service
options.d: Customs service and migration service

MT4-0333.stem: May a federal state body have positions that are not state-service positions?

options.a: Yes
options.b: Only if a register of such positions is established by a decree of the President of the Russian Federation
options.c: Yes, if state servants in those positions have access to information constituting a state or military secret of the Russian Federation
options.d: No

MT4-0334.stem: Which is NOT a principle of the state civil service?

options.a: Priority of human and civil rights and freedoms
options.b: Professionalism and competence of state civil servants
options.c: Accessibility of information about the state civil service
options.d: Rationality of state civil servants' activities

MT4-0335.stem: The relationship between the state civil service and municipal service is ensured through:

options.a: Performance of common tasks
options.b: Uniform basic qualification requirements for state civil-service and municipal-service positions
options.c: Correspondence between class ranks in the state civil service and municipal service
options.d: Accountability of local self-government bodies to state authorities

MT4-0336.stem: Which rules apply if an international treaty of the Russian Federation establishes rules different from those in state civil-service legislation?

options.a: The Labour Code of the Russian Federation
options.b: The rules of the international treaty
options.c: The Constitution of the Russian Federation
options.d: State civil-service legislation

MT4-0337.stem: A federal state civil servant, dissatisfied with a staffing decision by the head of the state body in which they serve, criticised the body's personnel policy on a radio programme. Have prohibitions associated with state civil service been breached?

options.a: Yes
options.b: No, because everyone may express their opinion, including in the media
options.c: Yes, if this is not part of the federal state civil servant's official duties
options.d: No, provided the federal state civil servant made no insulting statements or statements discrediting the head's honour and dignity

MT4-0338.stem: Who is eligible to enter the state civil service?

options.a: Citizens of the Russian Federation aged 18 or over who know the state language of the Russian Federation
options.b: Citizens of the Russian Federation aged 18 or over who know its state language and meet the qualification requirements
options.c: Citizens of the Russian Federation and foreign citizens aged 18 or over who know its state language and meet the qualification requirements
options.d: Foreign citizens aged 18 or over who know the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements

MT4-0339.stem: Can foreign citizens enter military state service in the Russian Federation?

options.a: No; this is prohibited by legal acts of the Russian Federation
options.b: Federal law provides for foreign citizens to enter military service in the Russian Federation under contract
options.c: In exceptional cases, by decree of the President of the Russian Federation, and only without remuneration
options.d: Yes, provided foreign citizens are denied access to information constituting a state or military secret of the Russian Federation

MT4-0340.stem: Which type of state-service position is not provided for in state-service legislation?

options.a: Federal state civil-service positions
options.b: State civil-service positions of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
options.c: Military positions
options.d: Law-enforcement service positions

MT4-0341.stem: Which listed category of civil-service positions is not provided for by the law of the Russian Federation 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation'?

options.a: Assistants (advisers)
options.b: Specialists
options.c: Support specialists
options.d: All listed categories are provided for

MT4-0342.stem: State civil-service positions are established to:

options.a: Support the exercise of the powers of a state body or a person holding a state office
options.b: Support the exercise of the powers of a state body, a person holding a state office, or the head of an autonomous or budget-funded institution subordinate to a state body
options.c: Support the exercise of a state body's powers
options.d: Support the exercise of the powers of a person holding a state office

MT4-0343.stem: Federal civil-service positions are established by (choose the most complete and correct answer):

options.a: A federal law or a resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.b: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation or a resolution of its Government
options.c: A federal law or a decree of the President of the Russian Federation
options.d: A federal constitutional law or a federal law

MT4-0344.stem: Which of the following is the highest rank that can be awarded to a civil servant in the Russian Federation?

options.a: Active Referent
options.b: Active Councillor
options.c: Active Civil Councillor
options.d: Active State Councillor

MT4-0345.stem: Civil-service positions are divided into the following categories:

options.a: Managers and subordinates
options.b: Managers, assistants (advisers), specialists, and support specialists
options.c: Managers and specialists
options.d: Managers, specialists, and support specialists

MT4-0346.stem: Which is not a duty of a federal state civil servant in the 'managers' category?

options.a: Taking measures to prevent conflicts of interest
options.b: Maintaining the level of qualification needed to perform official duties properly
options.c: Informing the employer's representative of a personal interest arising in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest
options.d: Joining a trade union

options.a: Positions established to provide organisational and documentation support for state bodies' activities
options.b: Positions established to assist persons holding state offices in exercising their powers
options.c: Positions of heads and deputy heads of state bodies and their structural units; heads and deputy heads of territorial offices of federal executive bodies and their structural units; and heads and deputy heads of state bodies' representative offices and their structural units, held for a fixed term or without a fixed term
options.d: Positions established to provide professional support for state bodies in carrying out their assigned tasks and functions

MT4-0348.stem: Which is NOT a basic duty of a federal state civil servant in the 'specialists' category?

options.a: Not disclosing information learned in the performance of official duties
options.b: Performing official duties in accordance with the official job regulations
options.c: Reporting renunciation of citizenship of the Russian Federation or acquisition of another state's citizenship on the date of renunciation or acquisition
options.d: Complying with the state body's service rules
options.e: Career advancement on a competitive basis

MT4-0349.stem: A civil servant must perform official duties in accordance with:

options.a: The job description
options.b: The official job regulations
options.c: The regulation on civil servants' personal data
options.d: The manager's requirements

MT4-0350.stem: Are official job regulations a mandatory document in the state civil service?

options.a: Yes
options.b: No
options.c: Only for positions in the highest and principal groups
options.d: Only if required by the regulation on the organisational unit

MT4-0351.stem: If a state civil servant in the 'specialists' or 'support specialists' category receives an unlawful instruction from their immediate supervisor, they must:

options.a: Carry out the instruction and then immediately report it, in writing or orally, to the employer's representative
options.b: Provide written reasons why the instruction is unlawful, citing provisions of Russian legislation that may be violated by carrying it out, and then carry it out
options.c: Carry out the instruction immediately
options.d: Provide written reasons why the instruction is unlawful, citing provisions of Russian legislation that may be violated, and obtain the supervisor's written confirmation of the instruction. If the supervisor confirms it without legal justification, refuse to carry it out.

MT4-0352.stem: Which is NOT considered a gross violation of a civil servant's official duties?

options.a: Absence from the workplace without good reason for more than four consecutive hours during a working day
options.b: Reporting for service under the influence of alcohol, narcotics or other intoxicants
options.c: Disclosure of information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal law
options.d: Failure to perform official duties for a valid reason
options.e: A breach of occupational safety requirements that causes serious consequences, such as an accident at work, an industrial accident or a disaster, or knowingly creates a real threat of such consequences

MT4-0353.stem: Civil servants' official job regulations are approved by:

options.a: The Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation'
options.b: The employer's representative
options.c: The relevant state civil-service management body
options.d: A legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation

MT4-0354.stem: Which may depend on the efficiency and performance indicators of a civil servant's professional service activities?

options.a: Remuneration
options.b: Length of leave
options.c: Number of official duties
options.d: All of the above

MT4-0355.stem: Restrictions and prohibitions in the civil service are established by:

options.a: A resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.b: The Federal Law 'On the State-Service System of the Russian Federation'
options.c: The Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation' and other federal laws
options.d: Official job regulations

MT4-0356.stem: Who exercises state supervision over compliance with Russian civil-service legislation?

options.a: The Presidential Administration of the Russian Federation
options.b: The Chair of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.c: The Prosecutor General of the Russian Federation
options.d: The Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation

MT4-0357.stem: A dispute concerning refusal of admission to the civil service is classified as:

options.a: A labour dispute
options.b: An administrative-law dispute
options.c: An individual service dispute
options.d: A collective service dispute

MT4-0358.stem: The public employer of a federal state servant is:

options.a: The federal state body
options.b: The Russian Federation
options.c: The employer
options.d: The Government of the Russian Federation

MT4-0359.stem: The head of a state body, a person holding a state civil office, or a representative of that head or person, exercising the powers of a public employer on behalf of the Russian Federation or one of its constituent entities, is:

options.a: The public employer's representative
options.b: The authorised employer
options.c: The authorised public employer
options.d: The employer's representative

MT4-0360.stem: Under the Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation', the public employer's representative means (choose the most complete and correct answer):

options.a: The head of a state body exercising the public employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity
options.b: The head of a state body or a person holding a state office, exercising the public employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity
options.c: The head of a state body, a person holding a state office, or a representative of that head or person, exercising the public employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity
options.d: The head of a state body, a person holding a state office, a representative of that head or person, or any other person exercising the public employer's powers on behalf of the Russian Federation or a constituent entity

MT4-0361.stem: A state civil servant may undertake other paid work under which conditions? Choose the most complete and correct answer.

options.a: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance
options.b: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and the work is scientific research
options.c: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and the work will not lead to a conflict of interest
options.d: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and will perform the work on weekends and/or public holidays

MT4-0362.stem: Which is NOT a basic right of a state civil servant?

options.a: Reviewing assessments of their professional service activities and other documents before they are added to their personnel file
options.b: Membership of a trade union
options.c: Access to state-secret information under the established procedure
options.d: Receiving state assistance with insurance of personally owned property

MT4-0363.stem: Restrictions associated with civil service include:

options.a: Acquiring income-generating securities in cases specified by federal law
options.b: Acquiring another state's citizenship or renouncing citizenship of the Russian Federation
options.c: Election to a paid elective office in a trade-union body, including an elected body of a primary trade-union organisation established within a territory's executive body
options.d: Engaging in entrepreneurial activity

MT4-0364.stem: To comply with requirements for official conduct, a civil servant must:

options.a: Refrain from conduct that discredits their honour and dignity
options.b: Refrain from discussing service matters in the presence of a senior manager
options.c: Avoid participation in mass events held by public organisations
options.d: Observe personal rights and interests when performing official duties

MT4-0365.stem: A civil servant has the right to:

options.a: Engage in entrepreneurial activity
options.b: Use the advantages of their official position for election campaigning
options.c: Stop performing official duties in order to resolve a service dispute
options.d: Perform other paid work after notifying the employer's representative in advance, provided this will not lead to a conflict of interest

MT4-0366.stem: For family or other valid reasons, on written application and by decision of the employer's representative, a civil servant may be granted unpaid leave lasting:

options.a: Two weeks
options.b: No more than one year
options.c: No more than three days
options.d: No more than six months

MT4-0367.stem: Basic and additional state guarantees in the state civil service apply to civil servants in which categories?

options.a: Managers and assistants (advisers)
options.b: Specialists
options.c: Support specialists
options.d: All of the above

MT4-0368.stem: Which is NOT a basic state guarantee for state civil servants?

options.a: Civil-service conditions enabling official duties to be performed in accordance with official job regulations
options.b: Medical insurance for the civil servant and their family members
options.c: Compulsory state social insurance against illness or incapacity during civil service
options.d: Reimbursement of relocation costs for the civil servant and their family when moving to another locality upon dismissal from civil service

MT4-0369.stem: Which is NOT an additional state guarantee for federal state civil servants?

options.a: Compensation for using a private vehicle for official purposes and reimbursement of related expenses in cases and under procedures established by Russian regulatory legal acts
options.b: Appointment to another civil-service position when a state body is abolished
options.c: Annual paid basic leave
options.d: A one-off subsidy for purchasing housing, once during the entire period of civil service, under the procedure and conditions established by a Russian Government resolution and a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity

MT4-0370.stem: Which is prohibited in connection with state civil service?

options.a: Membership of a trade union
options.b: Using the advantages of one's official position for election campaigning
options.c: Reviewing the contents of one's personnel file
options.d: Taking measures to prevent a conflict of interest

MT4-0371.stem: Which is NOT a requirement for state civil servants' official conduct under the Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation'?

options.a: Proceeding on the basis that recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms determine the meaning and substance of professional service activities
options.b: Performing professional service activities within the state body's competence established by Russian legislation
options.c: Maintaining neutrality so that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations and other organisations cannot influence professional service activities
options.d: Challenging violations of one's rights and legitimate interests in court

MT4-0372.stem: On dismissal from state civil service due to a state body's reorganisation or structural change, liquidation, or reduction of civil-service positions, a civil servant receives compensation equal to:

options.a: Three months' average earnings, excluding severance pay
options.b: Three months' average earnings, including severance pay
options.c: Four months' monetary remuneration, with no severance pay
options.d: Four months' monetary remuneration, including severance pay

options.a: An annual increase in remuneration
options.b: Compulsory state social insurance against illness or incapacity during state civil service
options.c: Official immunity
options.d: Reimbursement of land tax and personal property tax paid

MT4-0374.stem: Which is not a basic duty of a civil servant?

options.a: Performing official duties in accordance with official job regulations
options.b: Not disclosing state secrets or information learned concerning citizens' private lives and health or affecting their honour and dignity
options.c: Complying with the state body's service rules
options.d: Membership of a political party

MT4-0375.stem: Which is not a duty of a civil servant?

options.a: Maintaining neutrality so that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations and other organisations cannot influence professional service activities
options.b: Promoting interethnic and interfaith harmony
options.c: Giving preference to particular public or religious associations, professional or social groups, organisations or citizens
options.d: Observing established rules for public statements and the provision of official information

MT4-0376.stem: A civil servant has the right to:

options.a: Act as attorney or representative for third parties in the state body in which they serve, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law and other federal laws
options.b: Challenge violations of their rights and interests in state civil service in court
options.c: Establish political-party structures within state bodies
options.d: Publicly express judgments and assessments concerning the activities of the state body in which they serve, when this is not part of their official duties

options.a: Undertake other paid work after notifying the employer's representative in advance, provided this will not lead to a conflict of interest
options.b: Undertake any other paid work
options.c: Undertake any other paid work after notifying the employer's representative in advance
options.d: Undertake any other paid work without notifying the public employer in advance, provided this will not lead to a conflict of interest

MT4-0378.stem: A state civil servant may undertake other paid work under the following conditions:

options.a: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance
options.b: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and the work is scientific research
options.c: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and the work will not lead to a conflict of interest
options.d: If the civil servant has notified the employer's representative in advance and will perform the work on weekends and/or public holidays

options.a: Report renunciation of citizenship of the Russian Federation on the date of renunciation
options.b: Report renunciation of citizenship of the Russian Federation within two weeks of renunciation
options.c: Report renunciation of citizenship of the Russian Federation within 10 working days of renunciation
options.d: Report renunciation of citizenship of the Russian Federation within 3 days of renunciation

options.a: Travel outside the Russian Federation in connection with official duties at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except official business trips conducted under Russian law by agreement between Russian federal, regional or municipal bodies and foreign state or municipal bodies, international or foreign organisations
options.b: Carry out a supervisor's instruction even if it is unlawful
options.c: Inform the employer's representative of a personal interest arising in the performance of official duties
options.d: Receive benefits from individuals or legal entities in connection with official duties, including gifts, money, loans, services, entertainment, holidays, travel expenses and other benefits

MT4-0381.stem: A civil servant has the right to:

options.a: Career advancement on a competitive basis
options.b: Perform official duties in accordance with official job regulations
options.c: Safeguard state property, including property provided for official duties
options.d: Acquire income-generating securities in cases specified by federal law

options.a: Stop performing official duties in order to resolve a service dispute
options.b: Comply with the state body's service rules
options.c: Obtain access to state-secret information under the established procedure
options.d: Carry out an unlawful instruction after obtaining the supervisor's written confirmation

MT4-0383.stem: In connection with state civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:

options.a: Having access, under the established procedure and in connection with official duties, to state bodies, local self-government bodies, public associations and other organisations
options.b: Participating in the management of an economic entity, except housing, housing-construction, garage, gardening, vegetable-growing or dacha consumer cooperatives, property-owners' associations and trade unions
options.c: Participating for remuneration in the activities of a commercial organisation's governing body
options.d: Submitting information about themselves and their family members required by federal law under the established procedure

MT4-0384.stem: In connection with state civil service, a civil servant is prohibited from:

options.a: Performing any paid work
options.b: Engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through agents
options.c: Participating for remuneration in the activities of a commercial organisation's governing body
options.d: Registering ownership of real estate or other property

MT4-0385.stem: If a civil servant acquires another state's citizenship, the employer's representative must:

options.a: Terminate the service contract, remove the civil servant from their position and dismiss them from civil service from the date the other citizenship was acquired
options.b: Terminate the service contract, remove the civil servant from their position and dismiss them from civil service, notifying the relevant state body's trade-union body at least 2 months in advance
options.c: Terminate the service contract, remove the civil servant from their position and dismiss them from civil service from the date the other citizenship was acquired, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation
options.d: Terminate the service contract, remove the civil servant from their position and dismiss them from civil service, notifying them at least 1 month before dismissal

MT4-0386.stem: A civil servant may not be removed from their state civil-service position and dismissed at the employer's representative's initiative during:

options.a: Professional retraining
options.b: Study at a higher-education institution
options.c: Annual leave
options.d: Work with information containing state secrets

MT4-0387.stem: May a previously convicted citizen hold a state civil-service position if the conviction was expunged before the statutory rehabilitation period expired?

options.a: Yes, through a competitive selection on general terms
options.b: No; a citizen with any previous conviction may not hold a state civil-service position
options.c: No; this restriction applies only to persons seeking positions in the highest group of state civil-service positions

MT4-0388.stem: Qualification requirements concerning civil-service length or specialist work experience for federal civil servants are established by:

options.a: The Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation'
options.b: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation
options.c: A resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.d: Regulatory legal acts of federal state bodies

MT4-0389.stem: Mandatory qualification requirements for state civil-service positions include requirements concerning:

options.a: Level of professional education; length of state civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training; and the knowledge and skills needed for official duties
options.b: Level of professional education and length of state civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training
options.c: Level of professional education and the knowledge and skills needed for official duties
options.d: Level of professional education

MT4-0390.stem: Higher education at least at specialist-degree or master's-degree level is a qualification requirement for federal state civil-service positions in which categories? Choose the most complete and correct answer.

options.a: Managers, specialists and support specialists in all position groups
options.b: Managers, assistants (advisers) and specialists in the highest and principal position groups
options.c: Managers, assistants (advisers) and specialists in all civil-service position groups, and support specialists in the principal and leading groups
options.d: Assistants (advisers) and specialists in all civil-service position groups, and support specialists in the principal and leading groups

MT4-0391.stem: Which is not a qualification requirement for state civil-service positions?

options.a: A requirement concerning the specialty or field of training
options.b: A requirement concerning length of civil service
options.c: A requirement concerning work experience in the specialty or field of training
options.d: A requirement for prior military or alternative civilian service

MT4-0392.stem: Which regulatory legal act establishes requirements for length of civil service or work experience in the specialty or field of training for civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation?

options.a: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation
options.b: An order of the head of the constituent entity
options.c: A federal law
options.d: A law of the constituent entity

MT4-0393.stem: Entry into state civil service to fill a position, or appointment of a civil servant to another civil-service position, takes place:

options.a: Only following competitive selection
options.b: Following competitive selection, except in cases provided for by state civil-service legislation
options.c: Following an interview with the head of the state body
options.d: Only by appointment from among persons in the personnel reserve

MT4-0394.stem: The regulation on competitive selection for a vacant state civil-service position, defining its procedure and conditions, is approved by:

options.a: The Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation'
options.b: A legal act of the relevant state body
options.c: A legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation
options.d: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation

MT4-0395.stem: The regulation on the federal civil-service personnel reserve, establishing how the federal reserve and federal state bodies' reserves are formed and managed, is approved by:

options.a: A federal law
options.b: A regulatory legal act of the President of the Russian Federation
options.c: A resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.d: A regulatory legal act of the relevant federal executive body

MT4-0396.stem: Competitive selection for a state civil-service position may NOT be held:

options.a: When appointing to an indefinite-term civil-service position in the 'managers' category
options.b: When appointing a civil servant or citizen included in the civil-service personnel reserve
options.c: When concluding a fixed-term service contract
options.d: When appointing to specified civil-service positions involving access to state secrets, under a list approved by a regulatory act of the state body

MT4-0397.stem: A citizen is not admitted to competitive selection if:

options.a: They have a conviction expunged or spent under the procedure established by federal law
options.b: They are not a citizen of the Russian Federation
options.c: They are already in civil service
options.d: They do not have clearance for access to state secrets

MT4-0398.stem: When may a citizen be appointed to a state civil-service position without competitive selection?

options.a: When entering civil service for the first time
options.b: When concluding a fixed-term service contract
options.c: If no disciplinary penalties were imposed by another employer or employer's representative at their previous workplace or service post
options.d: If they hold the civil-service class rank of State Councillor of the Russian Federation, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class

MT4-0399.stem: When may a citizen be appointed to a state civil-service position without competitive selection?

options.a: If no disciplinary penalties were imposed by another employer or employer's representative at their previous workplace or service post
options.b: If they hold the following state civil-service class rank:
options.c: State Councillor of the Russian Federation, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class
options.d: By decision of the employer's representative when appointing to a position in the junior group of state civil-service positions

MT4-0400.stem: A citizen of the Russian Federation may be admitted to state civil service in which case?

options.a: A final court judgment has declared them to have limited legal capacity
options.b: They have acquired another state's citizenship
options.c: They refuse security-clearance procedures for state secrets or other federally protected secrets when the duties of the position sought or held require use of such information
options.d: They are closely related by blood or marriage to a civil servant, provided the position does not involve one being directly subordinate or accountable to the other

MT4-0401.stem: A citizen may not be admitted to state civil service, and a civil servant may not remain in it, if:

options.a: They fail to provide federally required information, or knowingly provide false information, about income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations
options.b: There is no procedure for granting access to state-secret information
options.c: They fail to provide a medical institution's certificate of health
options.d: They are distantly related to a civil servant and the position involves one being directly subordinate or accountable to the other

MT4-0402.stem: Who provides the employer's representative with the addresses of websites and/or web pages on which a civil-service applicant or civil servant has posted publicly available information, together with identifying details?

options.a: A citizen applying for a civil-service position
options.b: A civil servant
options.c: A municipal servant
options.d: Anyone who wishes

MT4-0403.stem: Municipal and civil servants provide the addresses of websites and/or web pages where they have posted publicly available information, and identifying details:

options.a: Once in their lifetime
options.b: Annually for the preceding calendar year, except information posted in the performance of a municipal servant's official duties
options.c: Every six months, except information posted in the performance of a municipal servant's official duties
options.d: Every 5 years, except information posted in the performance of a municipal servant's official duties

MT4-0404.stem: A civil servant's probation period is set for:

options.a: No more than 3 months
options.b: No more than 6 months
options.c: No more than 1 year
options.d: No more than 2 years

MT4-0405.stem: The purpose of probation on entry to state civil service is:

options.a: To assess the civil servant's suitability for the position
options.b: To develop strong motivation to perform official duties
options.c: To assess the quality and level of the civil servant's professional training
options.d: To award a class rank

MT4-0406.stem: A civil servant appointed to a state civil-service position is subject to probation. Which statement is correct?

options.a: Only some provisions of the Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation' apply during probation
options.b: A civil servant may not undertake additional professional education during probation
options.c: A period of temporary incapacity is not counted towards probation
options.d: The employer's representative may not terminate the service contract before probation expires

MT4-0407.stem: For which category of persons may probation be imposed upon appointment to a state civil-service position?

options.a: A state body's certificate of honour together with a one-off monetary reward or a valuable gift
options.b: A commendation together with a one-off monetary reward
options.c: A one-off monetary reward upon retirement on a state long-service pension
options.d: Early removal of a disciplinary penalty

MT4-0490.stem: To whom may a civil servant submit a written appeal against a disciplinary penalty? Choose the most complete and correct answer.

options.a: The state body's service disputes commission or a court
options.b: The head of the state body or a court
options.c: The state body's service disputes commission, the commission on state civil servants' official conduct and conflicts of interest, or a court
options.d: A court

MT4-0491.stem: A manager gave a civil servant an unlawful instruction, which the civil servant carried out. Who bears liability under federal laws?

options.a: Only the civil servant
options.b: Only the manager
options.c: Both the civil servant and the manager
options.d: This will be determined by an internal service inquiry

MT4-0492.stem: What must a civil servant do upon receiving an oral instruction from a manager that they consider unlawful?

options.a: Refuse to carry it out, citing its unlawfulness
options.b: Carry it out and report it in writing to the commission on official conduct and conflicts of interest
options.c: Give the manager written reasons why it is unlawful, citing Russian legal provisions that may be violated, and obtain written confirmation of the instruction. If the manager confirms it in writing, the civil servant must refuse to carry it out
options.d: Report it in writing to a higher manager and carry it out after that manager confirms in writing that it must be performed

MT4-0493.stem: Under the Federal Law 'On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation', a civil servant's family members are:

options.a: Parents, spouse and children, including adopted children
options.b: Spouse and minor children
options.c: Parents, siblings, spouse, children and other close persons
options.d: Spouse and children

MT4-0494.stem: When must an applicant for a state civil-service position submit information about their income, property and property-related obligations and those of their family members?

options.a: Upon entry to state civil service
options.b: Within one month after entry
options.c: Within three months after entry
options.d: Within one year after entry

MT4-0495.stem: May a bank use a civil servant's and their family members' income, property and property-obligation disclosures to assess creditworthiness for a loan?

options.a: No
options.b: Yes, with the civil servant's consent
options.c: Yes, with written consent from the civil servant and their family members
options.d: Yes, with the employer's representative's written consent

MT4-0496.stem: A civil servant submits income, property and property-obligation disclosures for themselves and their family. For whom are they NOT required to submit information?

options.a: Their spouse
options.b: Their 7-year-old son
options.c: Their 17-year-old daughter
options.d: Their 23-year-old son

MT4-0497.stem: A civil servant submits income, property and property-obligation disclosures for themselves and their family. For whom must they submit information?

options.a: Their 5-year-old son
options.b: Their father
options.c: Their brother
options.d: Their former spouse

MT4-0498.stem: Which sequence of actions is correct?

options.a: Issue the state body's act appointing the person to a state civil-service position, then conclude the service contract
options.b: Conclude the service contract, then issue the state body's appointment act
options.c: Conclude an employment agreement, then issue the appointment act
options.d: Conclude an employment agreement, then conclude a service contract

MT4-0499.stem: Citizens who held state-service positions listed in Russian regulatory legal acts must inform a new employer of their last service post when concluding employment agreements:

options.a: Always, whenever concluding an employment agreement
options.b: For five years after leaving state service
options.c: For two years after leaving state service
options.d: At the parties' discretion

MT4-0500.stem: When hiring a former state or municipal servant who held a position listed in Russian regulatory legal acts, within two years of their departure, the employer must notify the employer's representative at the former service post of the employment agreement within:

options.a: 5 days
options.b: 10 days
options.c: 30 days
options.d: 60 days

MT4-0501.stem: For service needs, may the employer's representative compensate a civil servant with an irregular working day for work beyond normal hours through overtime pay instead of additional paid leave?

options.a: No
options.b: Yes; the employer's representative may choose between that guarantee and compensation
options.c: Yes; the employer's representative acts according to the state's interests and financial capacity
options.d: Yes, with the civil servant's consent

MT4-0502.stem: An employer's failure to notify the public employer's representative at a former state servant's last service post when concluding an employment agreement entails:

options.a: Civil-law liability
options.b: Administrative liability
options.c: Financial liability
options.d: Criminal liability

MT4-0503.stem: Civil servants with an irregular working day receive annual additional paid leave lasting:

options.a: At least 10 calendar days
options.b: Less than 15 days
options.c: As established by the collective agreement, but no less than seven calendar days
options.d: Three calendar days

MT4-0504.stem: How long is annual basic paid leave for civil servants holding principal-group positions?

options.a: 28 calendar days
options.b: 30 calendar days
options.c: 35 calendar days
options.d: 40 calendar days

MT4-0505.stem: How many calendar days of additional paid long-service leave are granted for 15 or more years of civil service?

options.a: 7 calendar days
options.b: 10 calendar days
options.c: Determined individually in each case by the employer's representative

MT4-0506.stem: The combined duration of annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid long-service leave may NOT exceed:

options.a: 50 calendar days for the highest group, 45 days for the principal group, and 40 calendar days for other groups
options.b: 55 calendar days for the highest and principal groups and 45 calendar days for other groups
options.c: 45 calendar days for the highest and principal groups and 40 calendar days for other groups
options.d: No limits are established

MT4-0507.stem: A civil servant may obtain additional professional education:

options.a: Both in the Russian Federation and abroad
options.b: Only in the Russian Federation
options.c: Only in the Russian Federation and other CIS member states
options.d: In the Russian Federation, and abroad if relevant international agreements exist

MT4-0508.stem: Which is NOT a basis for sending a civil servant for additional professional education?

options.a: Appointment to another civil-service position through competitive promotion
options.b: Inclusion in the personnel reserve through competitive selection
options.c: The results of the civil servant's appraisal
options.d: The civil servant's written application

MT4-0509.stem: Additional professional education for a civil servant includes:

options.a: Professional retraining and further training
options.b: A second higher-education degree and professional retraining
options.c: An internship
options.d: Preparatory courses
options.e: Postgraduate research study and external degree candidacy

MT4-0510.stem: A civil servant's monetary remuneration consists of:

options.a: Position salary and class-rank salary
options.b: Position salary, class-rank salary and additional payments
options.c: Position salary, class-rank salary and financial support
options.d: Class-rank salary

MT4-0511.stem: What monthly long-service supplement to the position salary is payable for more than 15 years of civil service?

options.a: 20 percent
options.b: 30 percent
options.c: 15 percent
options.d: 25 percent

MT4-0512.stem: Is municipal-service time included when calculating length of civil service?

options.a: Yes
options.b: No
options.c: Yes, if the civil servant was in state service before holding municipal-service positions
options.d: Yes, at a ratio of 2 to 1

MT4-0513.stem: The amounts of position salaries and class-rank salaries for federal state civil servants are established by:

options.a: Federal law
options.b: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the Government's submission
options.c: The Government of the Russian Federation
options.d: The head of the relevant federal executive body for federal state civil servants holding positions in that body

MT4-0514.stem: What amount must the employer's representative pay a civil servant if their service contract is terminated because mandatory rules for its conclusion were violated through no fault of the civil servant?

options.a: One month's monetary remuneration
options.b: The salary
options.c: Two months' monetary remuneration
options.d: No payment is required

MT4-0515.stem: The maximum age for remaining in civil service is:

options.a: 55 for women and 60 for men
options.b: 60 years; this rule applies until 1 January 2017 under Federal Law No. 143-FZ of 23 May 2016
options.c: 65 years
options.d: 70 years

MT4-0516.stem: While a civil servant is suspended from their position and barred from performing official duties, monetary remuneration:

options.a: Accrues in full in all cases
options.b: Never accrues
options.c: Accrues when suspension is for resolution of a conflict of interest
options.d: Does not accrue when suspension is for resolution of a conflict of interest, but accrues in other cases

MT4-0517.stem: State supervision over compliance with Russian state civil-service legislation is exercised by:

options.a: Courts
options.b: Prosecution authorities
options.c: Justice authorities
options.d: The Control and Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation

MT4-0518.stem: The list of indicators for assessing the effectiveness of a constituent entity's executive authorities is approved by:

options.a: The constituent entity's legislature
options.b: The constituent entity's highest official
options.c: The President of the Russian Federation
options.d: Federal law

MT4-0519.stem: Which legal act approves the Register of Federal State Civil-Service Positions?

options.a: A decree of the President of the Russian Federation
options.b: A resolution of the Government of the Russian Federation
options.c: An order of the head of Rosreestr
options.d: An order of the Minister of Labour of the Russian Federation
